lines.text: The king will exalt himself above every god and honor a god of fortresses that his fathers did not know.
The king of the North storms out with chariots, and Edom, Moab, and the leaders of the Ammonites are delivered.
The king will gain control of Egypt's treasures, and the Libyans and Assyrians will submit to him.
Gabriel, the great prince, will rise up, and many who sleep in the dust will awake, some to everlasting life.
The man in linen swears by Him who lives forever: a time, times, and half a time.
